name: landscaping-evergreen
label: Greenfront — cinematic photo-led landscaping donor
source: Verbatim WSS port of the user-approved Lovable project bac7c069-3279-4616-a0ee-e4e447042003 (Greenfront Birmingham Bloom), owner-supplied source zip 2026-08-17. Built from the actual project source at token level: every identity string (business name, geography, phone, email, maps, socials, logo) is a WSS token; typography (Fraunces/Inter), the glass sticky header, the six-layer cinematic hero, the Property Care Planner widget, services, gallery, seasonal planner, service-area map, FAQ and footer ship exactly as designed. Since the a-plus static rebuild (2026-09, owner-approved direction) the shipped page is a hand-authored static shell; the engine's content injector renders verified client services/faqs/reviews into the shell's declared render targets, and the template's own copy is the standalone-preview default.

source_project.port_mode: verbatim source port; tokenized identity; WSS content bridge

stack: compiled Vite React (shadcn/ui) bundle + Tailwind CSS + Fraunces/Inter via Google Fonts; static hosting, no request-time build
persons_note: The source project does not supply owner/testimonial identities to this donor. Its business identity, phone, email, Birmingham/Meadowbrook geography, map target and source photographs are explicitly donor identity and may never survive hydration.
renders_note: Static-shell contract (2026-09-04): the engine's content injector renders verified services, faqs and reviews into the shell's own sections via the content_render_targets selectors (section#services, section#faq, section#reviews — all present in the static page). Reviews land on the design's clean cards with the honest review-ask card when a verified profile exists; there are no template testimonials to fall back to beyond the standalone-preview copy. About/coverage are NOT design sections; the engine injects its shared blocks for those.
photo_slots_note: FLAT ARRAY OF DIST-RELATIVE PATHS — the only shape engine.js reads. Slot 1 (added 2026-08-19, the concrete-elconstruction rung-3 pattern) is the hero photograph: it is the full-bleed cinematic hero layer, the hero_video poster AND the large final gallery tile, so a filled slot 1 puts the client's own photograph in all three places at once. Slots 2-6 are the gallery tiles in design order; slot 7 (truck) is the 'why' portrait. Every slot is referenced by the compiled bundle (verified against the built tree 2026-08-19). grass-texture is a background texture, not a slot. Filenames are content-hashed by Vite: REGENERATE THIS ARRAY FROM THE BUILT TREE ON EVERY REBUILD (the 2026-08-19 rebuild left every image hash unchanged).
hero_note: The design still paints its own six-layer hero (full-bleed photograph, morning-light glow, topographic contours, leaf-vein texture, planning grid, organic bed form, glass property-care panel) — but the hero is now MEASURED: hero_wash declares the selector so the engine's heroWash and mobile_fold passes can find it. The live Keane Landscaping build (2026-08-19) failed with mobile_fold donor_hero_unmeasured precisely because the previous manifest declared nothing. The design's own full-bleed hero IMG covers the wash pixels on the only route, so opting in cannot re-introduce the 2026-08-16 double-scrim flattening; what it buys is a measurable hero, the owner's mobile fold, and a client photograph washed behind the hero when one is verified.

hero_wash.verified: Render-proven 2026-08-19 on a local serve of this exact dist (scratch-landscaping/prove-staged-landscaping.cjs): section#top is the hero and its first child is the design's own full-bleed hero IMG (absolute inset-0, object-cover) which covers the wash on the single route, so pages_verified is the checked-and-explained empty list — the hvac-brandforge shape. The recorded colours are the RAW donor hero sample (deep evergreen section background hsl 140 45 8 = #0b1e11 behind white display type), used only when the theme pass does not apply.

hero_wash_note: ON 2026-08-19. The shipped scrim is derived by engine.js from the THEME pass slab/slabInk exactly as on hvac-premier and concrete-elconstruction; the raw sample above is the fallback when the theme pass does not apply. History, kept honest: the 2026-08-16 Greenfront port deliberately dropped hero_wash because the OLD shared wash double-scrimmed the previous CSS-only donor — but with no selector declared, heroWash AND mobile_fold both reported donor_hero_unmeasured on every live build (measured on Keane Landscaping, Wylie TX). On this design the full-bleed hero IMG owns the visible pixels and the wash sits behind it, so the selector is safe to declare. mobile_mute is deliberately empty for the function pass; muting the decorative SVG veils on the mobile fold is the visual pass's call.

ladder: the client's own verified clip at client_video_path (engine-placed, mp4, magic-byte verified)
the WSS-owned clip at wss_fallback_clip_path (operations drop-in, no code change)
the design photograph (hero-lawn, the shipped cinematic layer)
the drawn hero composition (always painted underneath)
hero_video.note: Owner's order, 2026-08-17: verbatim design, live video rung. The marked <video> sits behind the design's own overlay stack (morning light, hero gradient, topo, veins, grid, leaves) and reveals only when the ladder runtime arms a rung whose bytes shipped. Never a borrowed clip; reduced motion never arms.

visual_dna.hero: full-screen client photo with glass utility card and layered landscape-design motifs
visual_dna.mobile: single-column conversion path, visible semantic H1, full-width CTAs, no horizontal overflow
visual_dna.motion: hero depth drift and micro-interactions; fully suppressed for reduced motion

schema_note: The donor carries a content-free-safe WebSite/Organization/LocalBusiness graph. The shared content injector adds the richer service/review/FAQ/coverage graph when verified content exists.
truth_law_removals: No source-business service copy, Birmingham geography, source phone/email, testimonial or source image is present in shipped markup.
No stock or generated landscaping photograph is used as customer work. Only ownership-gated photo slots can reveal.
The seasonal planner is explicitly general planning guidance and does not assert a treatment, cadence, price or guarantee for the customer.
Reviews render only from verified review payloads and remain on high-contrast cards rather than a client photograph.
No free-estimate, same-day, licensed/insured or warranty claim is invented.
retirement_history: The old static donor was temporarily closed for guaranteed broken image slots, then reopened after repair. On 2026-08-16 its utilitarian visual shell was replaced by the Greenfront clean-room port because the old CSS-only/hero-wash composition failed the premium visual bar on live Grass Works and Thrive landscaping builds.

fixes_2026_08_19.what: The compiled hero baked the sentence 'Lawn care service in CITY, STATE - designed around your property' with only city/state token slots, so no fact about the client could reach the h1.
fixes_2026_08_19.found_by: Live sameness gate on the Keane Landscaping (Wylie TX) build: rendered_h1_not_client_derived — the rendered h1 carried neither the business name nor the composed headline.
fixes_2026_08_19.fix: The h1 now renders the engine's composed identity lines: HERO_LINE_A token (their proven motto, else their business name), HERO_LINE_B token (trade + market city) under the design's underline stroke, and HERO_LINE_C token (a verified rating sentence) which collapses at render when blank via a whole-string-literal const. The br after line A is the mobile-fold contract for slogan-led builds.

fixes_2026_08_19.what: No hero_wash entry meant heroWash AND mobile_fold both reported donor_hero_unmeasured on every build from this donor.
fixes_2026_08_19.fix: hero_wash declared with the real hero selector (section#top) and the raw hero sample colours; see hero_wash_note for why this cannot re-introduce the old double-scrim.

fixes_2026_08_19.what: The design had no reviews surface, so verified island reviews had nowhere to render and the engine appended its shared block under the design instead.
fixes_2026_08_19.fix: A reviews section (island-only, truth-law: no template testimonials, review-ask card only when a verified profile exists, else full collapse) now ships between the dark story band and the seasonal planner — the position the visual DNA always named ('clean review cards'). renders[] declares it so the engine no longer appends a duplicate.

fixes_2026_08_19.what: The hero photograph was not a photo slot, so a prospect's own photo could never fill the hero, the video poster or the large gallery tile.
fixes_2026_08_19.fix: assets/hero-lawn-BktA-aJ_.jpg is now slot 1 (the concrete-elconstruction rung-3 pattern: filled hero photo and video poster are the same image).

fixes_2026_08_20.what: Owner walkthrough punch list (video review of the live wss-test-absolute-lawn-care-landscaping-houston build), function half.
items: NAV: the 'Lawn Care' and 'Landscape' items pointed at ids that never rendered; the maps link fell back to a dead #area anchor. Nav is now Services / Work / Reviews (conditional, exactly like its section) / Planner / Contact / FAQ — every href resolves to a real section — and the maps chip renders only when a verified profile exists. Anchor jumps clear the fixed header (scroll-margin-top) and scroll smoothly only when motion is welcome.

HEADER PHONE PILL: fill and ink now read from ONE pair — the engine's slab/slab-ink variables with the design's primary pair as the standalone fallback — so a theme pass that repoints the primary pair asymmetrically (the live light-mode dark-on-dark pill) can no longer split them. Hover shifts brightness, never the pair.

HERO INK GUARD: hero text rides donor-owned --hero-ink (warm white) instead of the theme's slab ink, because the hero backdrop is the design's own dark photograph in every theme; alpha steps for the /90 and /85 inks are proven against the recorded hero sample in the harness.

fixes_2026_08_20.what: Owner walkthrough punch list, visual half (cheap-now items; the rest is the visual pass).
items: The headline underline traces itself through the line once (stroke-dash draw, reduced-motion-safe: the stroke sits complete with no animation).

Review cards carry the reviewer's verified Google face (googleusercontent-gated, the engine's own rule) with an initials monogram fallback, and a 'Google' source label ONLY on reviews carrying fields the verified Google lane alone emits (rating numeral, verified face, or publish date) — an intake-lane testimonial gets no badge it cannot prove.
Season cards: ink moved onto the card's own foreground pair and a 0.07-opacity wash of the seasonal photo slot (the client's own image on real builds) warms the flat dark boxes.
The Find/contact section moved above the planner and its links became floating obsidian chips (staggered drift, suppressed under reduced motion).
Footer carries the muted 'Built by wss-ai.com' attribution linking to https://wss-ai.com (owner's lead-gen loop).

fixes_2026_09_04.what: A-plus finalization lane on the static shell: the last CI run showed the shared hero-ssr fixture pinning this donor to the retired full-bleed SPA family while every other check passed.
items: IDENTITY ATOMS: donor_county declared and zips/geo populated (Birmingham donor identity, plumbing-clean's one-zip scale) so the leak gate has real buckets for county, zip and coordinate leaks instead of relying on name/phone/email alone.

OPTIONAL WELDS: the last three bare welds guarded — geo.position meta ([[NEED:GEO]]), the three county rows of the service-x-city grid (whole cell collapses without a county, mirroring the phone-optional rule that a blank token removes the construct rather than emptying it), and the footer {{DOMAIN}} attribution span.

HERO LADDER MADE REAL: the marked video now mounts data-hero-video hidden — the previous shell carried the walker and ladder island but the video never carried the marker, so no rung could ever arm. The walker reveals it on loadedmetadata; an exhausted ladder re-hides it; reduced motion never arms. The design photograph paints the .hero-media fold underneath (rung 3, always painted) so no-JS, reduced-motion and slow-clip views all land on the photo, never a blank slab.

BRAND-ASSET GATE (the 6/50 dry_run_500_donor_identity_detected rows): the donor shipped a fallback mark named logo-fallback.svg — a filename matching the fleet's donor-brand-asset leak regex (assets/logo-*.svg), so every build from this donor 500'd its own identity gate on a shipped file. Renamed to client-logo-fallback.svg (the merged siblings' exact convention: same bytes, same onerror role, the client- prefix the scan explicitly exempts).

SHARED FIXTURE RE-PINNED: test/hero-ssr-prerender.test.js now treats this donor family-aware (the exact change #683 made for the plumbing fixture) — the static shell reports {present:true, family:"static", reason:"static_h1_already_present"} and the no-JS guarantees (exactly one <h1>, business name, trade/market line) hold in the served markup. The SPA-mount bridge shape stays supported for any future revert.

heroVideo.note: Static-shell contract (2026-09-04): the marked <video> mounts hidden with its poster and the .hero-media paint-under photograph; the page's own ladder walker arms the #hero-video-ladder rungs and removes [hidden] only on loadedmetadata. Reduced motion never arms (walker guard plus the reduced-motion display:none rule). data-desktop-autoplay stays on the element as the design's desktop hook.

a_plus_static_rebuild.note: The a-plus lane ships a static multi-section page (the owner-approved design direction) over the verbatim SPA assets: the compiled bundle, css and design photographs still ship whole, the hero ladder island + walker live in the shell, and every identity string stays tokenized. The page loads the compiled css first and assets/design.css second so the engine's unlayered theme/plate/floor overrides (appended to the alphabetically-last stylesheet, the compiled css) still apply.
